versions.changelog:
- Improved support for both Chinese and English: all replies, test plans, and reports now follow the user's input language automatically.
- Updated report templates to include both Chinese and English versions.
- Clarified trigger phrases and usage instructions for international users.
- Removed the sample file skill-card.md.

- Initial release of the "webtest" skill for natural language-driven web regression testing.
- Automates end-to-end UI, regression, smoke, and acceptance tests by converting user requests into browser actions and assertions.
- Generates professional, human-readable test reports with step details, outcomes, screenshots, and defect summaries.
- Guides users to describe testing needs in plain language instead of writing automation scripts.
- Supports testing web flows like login, order placement, and admin console verification; accommodates test accounts and environment constraints.
